dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lawaia told me you're selling fish that were caught yesterday.

dialogues.speaker: Teuciztli
dialogues.text: That little rascal... I was wondering why we weren't making as much as we ought to. Turns out Lawaia's been up to no good... I guess I'm going to have to let him go.

dialogues.speaker: Teuciztli
dialogues.text: You truly are an honest soul. If only there were more people like you out there, business wouldn't be such a cutthroat venture. Here, take this. It's a token of my gratitude.
